assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and a history of atrial fibrillation, raising concern for intermittent arrhythmia recurrence.
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
Continuous monitoring is indicated to detect potential embolic sources or rhythm disturbances that may have been missed on standard ECG.
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) was medically necessary.
